posts.problem: Xbox wants you to pay 24 to 40 cents per hour to stream games you already bought

posts.solution_hypothesis: Pay‑per‑hour game streaming introduces a new monetisation layer that could shift how indie studios price cloud‑play offerings
posts.text:
Microsoft’s a‑la‑carte Cloud Playtime pricing lets players pay 24–40¢/hr for cloud‑play, adding a new revenue path but also a cost layer for indie studios.
